description: Send a private message in an existing contact_owner conversation; use check_reply to read it or contact_owner to open a new one. Supply the saved conversation_id and access_token. Returns the message and duplicate flag. Reuse an idempotency_key only for an identical retry; without one, a retry can duplicate the message. Limits apply, including 10 messages per conversation per minute; never send secrets or confidential data.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value only to retry the identical call safely; omit it for a new message.

name: send_followup

outputSchema.description: Receipt for a private conversation message.

duplicate.description: True if this was an identical retry.

title: Send a follow-up message
